name: Rate limited
when: Too many requests, or waiting in a queue

variants.name: Hourglass
variants.desc: Watches the sand run through, then flips it over.

variants.name: Ticket
variants.desc: Holds a queue ticket whose dots count down to its turn.

variants.name: Traffic light
variants.desc: Waits at a red light and gets ready on green.

variants.name: Countdown
variants.desc: A ring above its head runs down, then it hops.

variants.name: Catch breath
variants.desc: Panting with a sweat drop: it needs a moment.

parts.t: <g class="att att-mouth"><ellipse class="a mth" fill="{{a.eye}}" cx="{{a.mx}}" cy="{{a.my}}" rx="3.6" ry="4.6"></ellipse></g>

<g class="fx-hour" transform="translate({{a.side}} {{a.mo}})"><g transform="translate(92 50)"><g class="a hgl"><path class="pw" d="M-6 -10H6V-8Q6 -3 1.5 0Q6 3 6 8V10H-6V8Q-6 3 -1.5 0Q-6 -3 -6 -8Z"></path><path class="a snd1 gold2" d="M-4.3 -7.5H4.3Q4.3 -4 0 -1.2Q-4.3 -4 -4.3 -7.5Z"></path><path class="a snd2 gold2" d="M-4.3 8.5H4.3Q4.3 5.5 0 3.5Q-4.3 5.5 -4.3 8.5Z"></path><path class="sndf" d="M0 -1V8"></path><path class="dk2" d="M-7.5 -10.5H7.5M-7.5 10.5H7.5"></path></g></g></g>

<g class="fx-ticket" transform="translate(0 {{a.up}})"><g transform="translate(83 10)"><g class="a tkt"><path class="gst" d="M-11 -7H11V-2.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 0 11 2.5V7H-11V2.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 0 -11 -2.5Z"></path><g class="tkn tn3"><circle class="dk" cx="-5" cy="0" r="1.8"></circle><circle class="dk" cx="0" cy="0" r="1.8"></circle><circle class="dk" cx="5" cy="0" r="1.8"></circle></g><g class="tkn tn2"><circle class="dk" cx="-2.5" cy="0" r="1.8"></circle><circle class="dk" cx="2.5" cy="0" r="1.8"></circle></g><g class="tkn tn1"><circle class="dk" cx="0" cy="0" r="1.8"></circle></g></g></g></g>

<g class="fx-traffic" transform="translate({{a.side}} {{a.dn}})"><g transform="translate(93 48)"><path class="dk2" d="M0 14V33"></path><rect class="dk" x="-5.5" y="-14" width="11" height="28" rx="3"></rect><circle class="tl tlr" cx="0" cy="-8" r="3"></circle><circle class="tl tla" cx="0" cy="0" r="3"></circle><circle class="tl tlg" cx="0" cy="8" r="3"></circle></g></g>

<g class="fx-cring" transform="translate(0 {{a.up}})"><g transform="translate(50 3)"><circle class="ctrk" cx="0" cy="0" r="8"></circle><circle class="cdn" cx="0" cy="0" r="8" transform="rotate(-90)"></circle><circle class="dk" cx="0" cy="0" r="1.6"></circle></g></g>
